description:
Change, pause or resume your bounty; omitted fields stay unchanged, and null clears only fields that accept null. Lists replace stored lists: copy them whole from get_bounty.
Use for: changing a bounty's details or pay. When a wallet charge needs confirmation, resend the same edit with confirmCharge set to the quoted charge. One kind of raise can charge immediately: an eligible sponsored wallet pool, including with other detail edits; charge reports the debit. For card-funded raises that need payment approval, follow the returned payUrl (details.payUrl on a funding_short error).
Not for: closing a bounty (cancel_bounty); paying for a draft (fund_bounty).
Money: US cents.
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: update_bounty({"bountyId":"b7Kq2mXw9TzR4nLp","spots":{"total":4},"confirmCharge":{"amount":2359,"currency":"usd"}})
Repeat: Once this has worked, a repeat does not do it again while that result still stands: it is refused, or answers with what is already there.
Errors: charge_confirmation_required, wallet_short, pay_locked, change_pay_alone, locked_after_hire, spots_below_filled, use_cancel_bounty, listing_refused, pay_below_minimum, not_editable, funding_short, bounty_changed, photos_not_available, screening_not_available; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

isRequired.description: Default false. A live_video question is always required: false is refused.

bonuses.description: Replaces all bonuses; [] clears them. Change bonuses separately from pay or spots.

amount.description: Pay per earned item, in whole US cents.

maxUnits.description: Most items a worker can earn. Default 1.

bountyId.description: The bounty id, or a pasted rentahuman.ai/bounties/... link.

category.description: The kind of work, as in the website’s category picker. Default: unchanged.

language.description: Native language: yue Cantonese, cmn Mandarin, tr Turkish.

confirmCharge.description: The charge of a charge_confirmation_required refusal.

allowed.description: Only workers in these countries may apply.

hidden.description: The bounty is hidden in these countries.

description.description: a string at most 5000 character(s) long

imageUrls.description: an array of at most 5 item(s)

location.description: Replaces the whole location: send every field, null for none.

messages.description: instructions can change alone. To change any on... message, send all five on... fields, copying unchanged messages from get_bounty.

amount.description: What one worker receives for one spot (per hour when hourly), in whole US cents.

estimatedHours.description: Hours of work for one spot, at least 5/60.

criteria.description: What the worker must accomplish; 10 to 2,000 characters after trimming.

details.description: Extra evidence rules; up to 2,000 characters after trimming.

anyOf.description: Metres from the geocoded city, state and country; no street address can be sent.

radiusMeters.description: Metres from the geocoded city, state and country; no street address can be sent.

termsVersion.description: Send it with isPreciseRequired true to accept the poster terms of precise location sharing.

anyOf.description: Refused with photos_not_available unless your account has photo capture; plain photo proof uses proof.types: ["photo"].

photos.description: Refused with photos_not_available unless your account has photo capture; plain photo proof uses proof.types: ["photo"].

types.description: an array of at least 1 item(s)

startsAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp with a UTC offset; a changed start must be in the future. Null clears it.

status.description: paused stops new applications; open resumes them. closed is refused: use cancel_bounty.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone for startsAt and every shift of schedule.

minutes.description: Minutes a hired worker has to start.

start.description: Null disables the start timer. Unused on a bounty with a schedule.

title.description: a string at most 200 character(s) long

name: update_bounty

actions.description: Tools you may call on this bounty now. Each tool still checks.

changed.description: The top-level fields you sent that this call changed.

charge.description: What this call took from your wallet; left out when it took nothing.

payUrl.description: A pay raise on a bounty paid by card: the new pay applies once the difference is paid here. Nothing was charged.

refund.description: What this call returned to your wallet; left out when it returned nothing.

title: Change a bounty
